THE ANOMALY, STATED AND NOT EXPLAINED AWAY
  Gold FELL 1.32% on a day when the VIX rose 10.73% and bitcoin fell 2.92%. That is not the classic
  flight-to-safety pattern, in which gold rises with volatility. Government bonds DID rally (UK and
  US yields both lower), so the safety bid went into bonds, not metal. This looks like broad
  liquidation rather than a hedge, but NO APPROVED SOURCE I HAVE READ ATTRIBUTES IT, so the edition
  describes the divergence and does not assert a cause.

CONTINUITY: no value is carried forward; every figure is a fresh read. CNBC's previous-close fields
were checked against our own published series. Note the gilt's previous close reads 5.3843, whereas
we published 5.41 yesterday lunchtime — that is consistent, because ours was a 12:15 intraday read
and 5.3843 is where the market actually closed. No contradiction.

FEED RELIABILITY NOTE: for yield symbols this feed's percentage-change field remains unreliable (it
showed -0.75% for the French 10-year against a positive absolute change of +0.0941). The level and
the ABSOLUTE change are coherent and are what we use; the percentage field is ignored for yields.
